usage: Use lattice authority enforce runner --live --storyId=B-current with the senior Authority runner env; the signed /jobs/claim payload now carries claim.storyId while SSE jobIds remain advisory.
expectedOutcome: A story-scoped live runner sends claim.storyId for the requested story and does not lease stale queued jobs from discarded or unrelated stories.
actualTranscript: node packages/main/dist/tasks/authority-enforce-runner-smoke.js exited 0 with: authority enforce runner smoke passed; dry-run planned register/heartbeat/claim without provider execution; claimed-job plannedSteps consumed through the bounded executor with authority DONE gated by a verified receipt.
outcomeDiff: No functional difference from expected; the initial handler-only fix missed command-catalog parsing, and the final implementation now covers the real CLI alias/parser path.
limitations: Staging must run a server build with storyId/jobId claim selector support; this local story proves CLI behavior and focused fake-server stale queue handling, not a fresh deployed staging live run.
pitfalls: Concept review found the main pitfall: command-catalog validation stripped --live and --storyId before handler dispatch. Future Authority CLI flags need catalog/parser smoke coverage, not only direct handler tests.
